source.label: Williams Little Chief factory instruction card

strategy.overview: Little Chief is a build, double, and collect Bonus game. Send the ball up top to complete A and B, which opens the center-right gate and lights the top center lane. Take that lit center lane or the center saucer to light Double Bonus, then shoot through the open gate to collect the built value.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Little Chief, shoot up top until A and B are complete. That opens the center-right gate and lights the top center lane. Take the lit center lane or the center saucer to light Double Bonus, then shoot through the open gate to collect Bonus. Rebuild and repeat.
strategy.summary: Build Bonus with top lanes, rollovers, and standups. Complete A and B, light Double Bonus at the top center lane or center saucer, then collect through the open center-right gate once the base Bonus is at least 7,000.

quickInfo.name: Complete A and B
quickInfo.summary: Open the center-right Bonus gate and light the top center lane.

quickInfo.name: Light Double Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Collect the lit top center lane or shoot the center saucer.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Shoot through the open center-right gate after building and doubling the value.

quickInfo.name: Center saucer ladder
quickInfo.summary: Repeated saucer or lit-center-lane collections advance the adjustable Extra Ball and Special awards.

steps.text: Plunge for A, then keep shooting up top until both A and B are complete.
Use the lit top center lane when available; otherwise shoot the center saucer to light Double Bonus.
Keep sending the ball up top until base Bonus reaches at least 7,000.
From the left flipper, shoot through the open center-right gate to collect the doubled Bonus.
Repeat the A-B, Double Bonus, and collect cycle while using dead bounces or lane transfers to reach the needed flipper.
Complete A and B to open the collect gate.
Light Double Bonus and keep building the base value.
Collect through the center-right gate, then rebuild.

machineSetup: Confirm whether Extra Ball and Special are enabled or converted to points, and note the installed saucer-award ladder before play.
Test the A and B lanes, top center lane lamp, center saucer and kickout, Bonus unit, center-right gate, collect switch, and the dangerous posts around the saucer feed.
